mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalVolunteers, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activeVolunteers, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as inactiveVolunteers, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingVolunteers, COALESCE(SUM(vu.total_service_hours), 0) as totalServiceHours, COALESCE(AVG(vu.total_service_hours), 0) as avgServiceHours, SUM(CASE WHEN vu.created_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as monthlyNewVolunteers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vs.last_activity_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN vu.id END) as activeVolunteers30Days FROM volunteer_user vu LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(created_time) as last_activity_time FROM service_record WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) vs ON vu.id = vs.user_id WHERE vu.deleted = 0
